source: Deadlock game-file data via the Deadlock Static Assets API

heroes.name: Abrams
heroes.playstyle: Abrams is a Hero in Deadlock. He is a hard-boiled, hard-hitting bruiser of a character that focuses on engaging enemies in close combat. Abrams is a juggernaut on the battlefield, tapping into the dark power of his Tome to Siphon Life from nearby enemies and utilizing his Infernal Resilience to brush off the damage he takes. With a sudden Shoulder Charge or area stun from his Seismic Impact, he can aggressively initiate fights and isolate fragile targets from the rest of their team to set up a devastating burst of damage.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.description: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.description: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun. If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.description: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.description: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.

heroes.name: Apollo
heroes.playstyle: Apollo is a Hero in Deadlock. With Flawless Advance the fencer begins his approach, timing his strikes perfectly to inflict more damage. Counter-attacks aren't a concern for Apollo, as a flourish of his blade deflects the damage and triggers a quick Riposte, and Disengaging Sigil allows him to jump out of the fray with ease. For his final blow, Apollo dons his fencer's mask and channels Ixia 's might with Itani Lo Sahn, leaving enemies defeated in his wake.

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.description: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist. Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.description: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.description: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or Fire to delay the cast.

heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
heroes.playstyle: Bebop is a Hero in Deadlock. A scrap golem with a big heart and a bigger extendable arm, Bebop is a potent threat on the battlefield when supported by his team. His Grappling Arm can pull friends and enemies alike towards him, saving them from certain doom or guaranteeing it. Bebop can attach Sticky Bombs to nearby foes and launch them in any direction with a powerful Exploding Uppercut. For any foes left standing, Bebop's Hyper Beam can cut across the battlefield and finish them off.

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.description: Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback. When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.description: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.description: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.description: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.

heroes.name: Billy
heroes.playstyle: Billy is a Hero in Deadlock. A white hot ball of rage, furious at the very notion of... something. Billy is a chaotic front-liner who never backs down from a challenge. With Rising Ram he gets up close and personal, before slamming down with Bashdown to create shockwaves through his enemies. Running isn't even an option when Billy can use his ultimate Chain Gang to grapple enemies and pull them back in. A quick swig from his bottle gets him Blasted, and his enemies totally wrecked.

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.description: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage. The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.description: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.description: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7s.

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.description: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage. The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

heroes.name: Calico
heroes.playstyle: Calico is a Hero in Deadlock, a former monster hunter turned hired assassin. Possessing her cat, Ava, Calico uses the shadows to her advantage to surprise her foes, slinging Gloom Bombs and attacking with a Leaping Slash for damage and healing. By Returning to the Shadows, she can turn any fight to her advantage, disappearing after a fight or engaging again when the enemy least expects her.

abilities.name: Gloom Bombs
abilities.description: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage. Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.

abilities.name: Leaping Slash
abilities.description: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage. If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.

abilities.name: Ava
abilities.description: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap. Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

abilities.name: Return to Shadows
abilities.description: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage. After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.

heroes.name: Celeste
heroes.playstyle: Celeste is a Hero in Deadlock. It's not every day that Coney Island's biggest star, The Dazzling Celeste, performs on the streets of Manhattan. Her show begins with Light Eater, where a deep breath lit by her blazing baton coats enemies in front of her, and grants increased damage against them. Following that up, she envelops herself in the prismatic shield of her Dazzling Trick, which explodes and silences nearby enemies who break it. Try not to get distracted by her gliding gracefully through the air, or by the dance of her Radiant Daggers, as you'll regret being underneath them when they rain down from above. As for her memorable final act, the Shining Wonder will make her allies go OOH and her foes go AGGHHH!

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.description: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.description: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.description: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.description: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

heroes.name: Drifter
heroes.playstyle: Drifter is a Hero in Deadlock. Something ancient has arrived in New York... a nameless horror known only as the Drifter. Relentless as time, as certain as death, once Drifter sets his eyes on a victim there's nothing they can do to stop him. They can try to run, but his Bloodscent drives him forward, leading him to isolated prey. Even if they manage to escape it doesn't matter, as Stalker's Mark allows Drifter to appear right behind his enemies before lunging in for the kill with a vicious Rend. Soon Eternal Night comes, and a faint whistling in the breeze will be joined by a chorus of screams.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.description: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.description: Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar. You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.description: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed.

heroes.name: Dynamo
heroes.playstyle: Professor Dynamo is a Hero in Deadlock. He is a man of wit, using his brain and his brawn to provide support to his teammates by healing them, teleporting them, knocking his opponents into the air, and when the time is right, unleashing a Singularity which can drastically shift the tides of battle.

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.description: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.description: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. Alternate cast: Bring nearby allies with you.

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.description: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.description: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing < spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

heroes.name: Graves
heroes.playstyle: Graves is a Hero in Deadlock. The dead have been making a whole lot of demands lately, and only Graves has the courage to oblige. That severed lich hand she found in the cemetery has proven itself a valuable ally, allowing her to latch onto her enemies and steal their power for herself. Her curiosities about the passage of life are further put to use with Jar of Dead, collecting the remains of the fallen, shaking them up, and throwing them back at her enemies to grant those remorseful spirits a final shot at revenge. With Grasping Hands she strikes a deep crack in the earth, allowing those down below to grab onto enemies' ankles and stop them from escaping her reach. And when all else fails, a Borrowed Decree will summon the dead to fight alongside her.

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.description: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.description: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast Alternate cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.description: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
abilities.description: Innate: Abilities can summon Ghouls that shamble toward the enemy base, dealing melee damage. They explode when they approach a hero or objective, dealing spirit damage in an area and applying a brief slow

heroes.name: Grey Talon
heroes.playstyle: Grey Talon is a Hero in Deadlock. He is a clever, long-range combatant that uses his powerful bow in combination with traps and mystical flight to pin down and destroy his foes. With the ability to charge his arrow shot for powerful effect, Grey Talon can harry his foes at a distance before launching a guided Spirit Owl to finish them off.

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.description: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or Fire to hold the shot.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.description: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. Alternate cast for reduced jump height. Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.

abilities.name: Spirit Snare
abilities.description: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage. Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

abilities.name: Guided Owl
abilities.description: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold Move forward to accelerate the owl. Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

heroes.name: Haze
heroes.playstyle: Haze is a Hero in Deadlock. She works as a secret agent in the Sandman Division of OSIC, fighting as a devastating assassin character who excels in Fixating on foes that are out of position and swiftly ending them. Her Smoke Bomb lets her sneak up on enemies before knocking them out with a Sleep Dagger and unleashing a hail of gunfire at close range. In desperate situations, Haze can enter her Bullet Dance to avoid return fire while dispatching her remaining targets.

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.description: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, two if the hit is a headshot.

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.description: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

heroes.name: Holliday
heroes.playstyle: Holliday is a Hero in Deadlock. She is a sheriff, relying on her aim with her trusty heirloom revolver and a litany of abilities to take down her enemies. With a Crackshot of her pistol, she can slow and damage her foes from a distance before launching an explosive Powder Keg with her Bounce Pad or a melee attack. To isolate her foes, she can wrangle them with her Spirit Lasso and drag them into the attacks of her allies.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.description: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup. The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel infront of Holliday.

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.description: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.description: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.description: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun. Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
heroes.playstyle: Infernus is a Hero in Deadlock. He is an Ixian with a powerful control of flame that he uses to enhance his speed and ignite his enemies. Combining his Flame Dash with the ability to spew a Napalm catalyst, Infernus can chase down and ignite his foes with a deadly Afterburn. Any targets left standing will be subject to his explosive Concussive Combustion, knocking them out and leaving them vulnerable to further immolation.

abilities.name: Napalm
abilities.description: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.description: Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time. Hold Move forward while active to dash farther.

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.description: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.description: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally
heroes.playstyle: Ivy is a Hero in Deadlock. She is a gargoyle-turned-vigilante with potent supportive and disruptive abilities to assist her allies in combat. After setting up a Kudzu Connection with an ally to share healing and buffs, she can grow patches of Entangling Thorns and transform into her Stone Form to damage and stun the enemy while healing herself. With her abilities of flight, she can pick up any ally or create a bomb and fly them to any point on the battlefield, choosing to either explosively Air Drop them into the middle of the enemy battle group, or rescue an ally from danger.

abilities.name: Entangling Thorns
abilities.description: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damage and slows enemies in its radius.

abilities.name: Kudzu Connection
abilities.description: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection Connection requires line of sight.

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.description: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

abilities.name: Air Drop
abilities.description: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies. Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.

heroes.name: Kelvin
heroes.playstyle: Kelvin is a Hero in Deadlock. He is a dedicated, undead scientist with a bevy of freezing abilities to slow his enemies and heal allies. He can conjure an Ice Path under his feet for faster movement for himself and his team, throwing Frost Grenades and firing his Arctic Beam at nearby enemies to set them up for his companions' attacks. Tactical usage of his Frozen Shelter ice dome can protect and heal allies while trapping hapless opponents.

abilities.name: Frost Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.description: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.description: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
abilities.description: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed. Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.role: Sacrifices health then drains it back
heroes.playstyle: Lady Geist is a Hero in Deadlock. A socialite with a necromantic pact, Lady Geist consumes her own health for her abilities while draining the life away from opponents. Sacrificing her life force to launch Essence Bombs and blood shards filled with Malice, Lady Geist can regain lost health with Life Drain, sapping enemy heroes and units of their health. Her Soul Exchange swaps health values with an enemy hero, turning the odds against them for a killing blow.

abilities.name: Essence Bomb
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. Alternate cast to give health to friendly Heroes.

abilities.name: Malice
abilities.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

abilities.name: Soul Exchange
abilities.description: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.role: Dives down to stomp his foes
heroes.playstyle: Jacob Lash is an asshole, and a Hero in Deadlock. The Lash is a brutal bruiser who eagerly initiates fights and chases down fleeing opponents. He leaps into combat with his Grappling hook, Flogging his foes with a life-stealing whip and stomping the ground with a Ground Strike that damages multiple targets. If the enemy team groups up, the Lash can pick them all up at once and Death Slam them into the ground.

abilities.name: Ground Strike
abilities.description: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.description: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.

abilities.name: Flog
abilities.description: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Death Slam
abilities.description: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed. Press Fire to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.role: Controls the battle with combat turrets
heroes.playstyle: McGinnis is a Hero in Deadlock. The head of Fairfax Industries Military R&D department, McGinnis has a high opinion of her own work which includes her machine gun, numerous automatic Mini Turrets, Spectral Walls that she can create to protect teammates, hold down positions and trap enemies, a Medicinal Specter that dispenses health to nearby allies, and finally, a devastating spectral Heavy Barrage that can reach even faraway enemies.

abilities.name: Mini Turret
abilities.description: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

abilities.name: Medicinal Specter
abilities.description: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.

abilities.name: Spectral Wall
abilities.description: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press Fire or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

abilities.name: Heavy Barrage
abilities.description: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

heroes.name: Mina
heroes.playstyle: Mina is a Hero in Deadlock; a glass cannon that rakes enemies with her umbrella and delivers quick bursts of Spirit damage at range with her passive, Love Bites. She can transform into bats and escape when things get a bit too messy. Each time she triggers Love Bites, her vampiric powers grow stronger. This builds toward her ultimate, Nox Nostra, which unleashes a massive swarm of bats that hunt down and silence nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.description: Active: Slash with your umbrella, dealing spirit damage, increasing with their missing health. Receive a heal for every target killed. Passive: Holding Zoom / alt-fire causes you to briefly float. Rake executes non-heroes below 60 health.

abilities.name: Sanguine Retreat
abilities.description: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.

abilities.name: Love Bites
abilities.description: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage. Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Nox Nostra
abilities.description: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence. Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.role: Times his shots and catches fleeing targets
heroes.playstyle: Mirage is a Hero in Deadlock. He is agile and uses powerful wind-based abilities for disruption. By throwing out Fire Scarabs and transforming into a Dust Devil, Mirage can damage, lift up, steal life and elude his targets while applying Djinn's Mark to enemies to enhance his attacks. When the time is right, he can Travel across the map in an instant to assist his allies, hunt down weak foes and take care of objectives.

abilities.name: Fire Scarabs
abilities.description: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

abilities.name: Dust Devil
abilities.description: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

abilities.name: Djinn's Mark
abilities.description: Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage. There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks

abilities.name: Traveler
abilities.description: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

heroes.name: Mo & Krill
heroes.playstyle: Mo & Krill are Heroes in Deadlock. Highly respected members of America's underworld, together they are a disruptive and mobile pair that can Burrow around the battlefield and leave their enemies in ruins. Jumping out of ground let Mo & Krill catch their enemies unprepared, and if they are prepared then that will be rectified when Sand Blast jams their weapons. The duo is not concerned about being ambushed by a large group of people, as Scorn will force them to scatter or else risk the pair surviving long enough for backup to arrive. If some poor moron oversteps, Mo and Krill can Combo them to render them helpless.

abilities.name: Scorn
abilities.description: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.description: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.

abilities.name: Sand Blast
abilities.description: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.

abilities.name: Combo
abilities.description: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

heroes.name: Paige
heroes.playstyle: Paige is a Hero in Deadlock. Citizens of Manhattan will learn to appreciate the power of the written word when Paige joins the fight. With the mere toss of a book she can conjure a Bookwyrm that sears enemies who get too close, or bind them to the ground with Captivating Read. Waning allies will find themselves emboldened by Plot Armor, granting them the courage to fight another day. Fantasy becomes reality with Rallying Charge, summoning an entire cavalry to gallop across the city.

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.description: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.description: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.description: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.description: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

heroes.name: Paradox
heroes.playstyle: Paradox is a Hero in Deadlock. She wields time manipulation with potent disruption and slowing abilities. With a charged Kinetic Carbine, she can threaten her enemies at any range while damaging and slowing them with thrown Pulse Grenades and well-placed Time Walls. At just the right moment, Paradox can activate her Paradoxical Swap to change places with her target, dropping them into a dangerous situation amongst her team.

abilities.name: Pulse Grenade
abilities.description: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.

abilities.name: Time Wall
abilities.description: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced.

abilities.name: Kinetic Carbine
abilities.description: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, Zoom / alt-fire to timeslow your movement.

abilities.name: Paradoxical Swap
abilities.description: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

heroes.name: Pocket
heroes.playstyle: Pocket is a Hero in Deadlock. Having to fight in the Ritual for the chance to stop their father, Pocket prefers to fight up close thanks to their powerful shotgun and highly mobile abilities. Opening their magic briefcase to Barrage groups of enemies with spiritual bursts, Pocket may use their Flying Cloak to teleport beside their targets and unload their shotgun; disappearing inside their Enchanter's Satchel to avoid return fire. When surrounded by enemies, Pocket can unleash an Affliction to slowly eat away at their health, setting their enemies up for a devastating attack.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.description: Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks. Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float. Casting AirDash or Flying Cloaking will not cancel Barrage.

abilities.name: Flying Cloak
abilities.description: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

abilities.name: Enchanter's Satchel
abilities.description: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

abilities.name: Affliction
abilities.description: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby. Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

heroes.name: Rem
heroes.playstyle: Rem is a Hero in Deadlock. An accidental stowaway from the world of dreams, Rem has found himself stranded in the city that never sleeps. Pillow fights are Rem's preferred form of conflict, tossing his favorite pillow at enemies to knock them back when they're getting too close. His friends, however, he likes to keep nearby - leaping to their aid when things get dicey and taking a quick nap on their shoulder. His Lil Helpers are curious creatures, taking interest in everything the streets of New York have to offer, and cheering on his allies as they go. Ultimately when Naptime hits, no one will be able to keep their eyes open.

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.description: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.description: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.description: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.description: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.

heroes.name: Seven
heroes.playstyle: Seven is a Hero in Deadlock. A megalomaniac scientist who substitutes his absence of ethics with a wide array of electric attacks, Seven excels in rapidly taking control of the battlefield by denying areas with Lightning Balls and Surging his gun to punish his foes for staying close together. After putting his enemies in their place with Static Charge, Seven is free to discharge himself into a Storm Cloud and fry them alive.

abilities.name: Lightning Ball
abilities.description: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

abilities.name: Static Charge
abilities.description: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.description: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

abilities.name: Storm Cloud
abilities.description: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.role: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill
heroes.playstyle: Shiv is a Hero in Deadlock. Seeking atonement for his past life, Shiv is a cutthroat monster hunter with a cause, conducting hit-and-run attacks and picking off vulnerable targets. Shiv can efficiently traverse the battlefield and catch up with his targets by making full use of his shotgun's recoil. Flinging Serrated Knives to bleed his foes from range, Shiv initiates close quarters combat on his terms by dashing to them while Slicing and Dicing through those standing in his way. By continuously dealing damage, Shiv builds Rage which enhances his abilities and allows him to be a one man army. Withstanding grievous damage via Bloodletting, Shiv finishes off dying targets with a devastating Killing Blow.

abilities.name: Serrated Knives
abilities.description: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.description: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.

abilities.name: Bloodletting
abilities.description: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

abilities.name: Killing Blow
abilities.description: Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead. Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s

heroes.name: Silver
heroes.playstyle: Silver is a Hero in Deadlock, making her living tracking down lowlifes, but today New York’s misanthrope lycanthrope plans on summoning a god. Fortunately, her career as a bounty hunter has prepared her well for all that the ritual requires. She makes quick work of adversaries by catching them with her Entangling Bola, Boot Kicking them in the face, and finishing them off with a Slam Fire from her rifle. But inevitably, the Lycan Curse comes calling whether she likes it or not, and her foes will regret being too close when it does.

abilities.name: Slam Fire
abilities.description: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

abilities.name: Boot Kick
abilities.description: Dash forward and kick the first enemy hit, dealing melee damage while pushing yourself off and marking them.

abilities.name: Entangling Bola
abilities.description: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

abilities.name: Lycan Curse
abilities.description: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

heroes.name: Sinclair
heroes.playstyle: Sinclair is a Hero in Deadlock. With their trusty magic wand, they can shoot Vexing Bolts to surprise enemies and use magic to turn them into Rabbits. The Spectral Assistant amplifies their damage and can serve as a fast escape route. Sinclair can even turn their enemies' abilities against themselves with their surprising final trick, Audience Participation.

abilities.name: Vexing Bolt
abilities.description: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

abilities.name: Spectral Assistant
abilities.description: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage. While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant. Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

abilities.name: Rabbit Hex
abilities.description: Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions. Hex does not interrupt abilities.

abilities.name: Audience Participation
abilities.description: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

heroes.name: The Doorman
heroes.playstyle: The Doorman is a Hero in Deadlock. He's proper, he's polite, but the humble Doorman of The Baroness Hotel is more than meets the eye. A brisk ring of his Call Bell leaves nearby enemies disoriented, and his high-speed Luggage Cart knocks them right off their feet. Do you find yourself getting lost easily in the streets of Manhattan? Don't worry, The Doorman is here to provide a shortcut with his Doorway whenever the need arises. And only the most special of enemies get to experience the trip of a lifetime to The Baroness Hotel.

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.description: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow. Can be shot to detonate early.

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.description: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.description: Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with Alternate cast to target friendly heroes instead.

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.description: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.

heroes.name: Venator
heroes.playstyle: Venator is a Hero in Deadlock. He doesn't walk the righteous path, he blazes the trail so that others may do so safely. His biggest challenge is knowing which weapon to use first. Firing a Consecrating Grenade into the fray softens up his enemies and keeps them from restoring health, and his Hex-Lined Snap Trap scatters across the ground to lock them in place. A Gutshot from his shotgun will knock back enemies who get too close, and when the time is right, Ira Domini will rid the world of evil once and for all.

abilities.name: Consecrating Grenade
abilities.description: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.

abilities.name: Gutshot
abilities.description: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.

abilities.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
abilities.description: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

abilities.name: Ira Domini
abilities.description: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage. The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.

heroes.name: Victor
heroes.playstyle: Victor is a Hero in Deadlock who walks the line between life and death. Victor has learned to harness pain, shocking himself with Jumpstart to get his adrenaline rushing and his faulty heart pumping. He welcomes incoming damage with open (albeit mismatched) arms, channeling it into his Pain Battery and granting enemies a taste of the pain he endures. Get too close and risk getting caught in his Aura of Suffering, but hey, at least you'll be suffering together. And just when you think you've taken him down, he'll piece himself back together and live again!

abilities.name: Pain Battery
abilities.description: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.

abilities.name: Jumpstart
abilities.description: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.

abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
abilities.description: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
abilities.description: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.

heroes.name: Vindicta
heroes.playstyle: Vindicta is a Hero in Deadlock. She is a mobile and powerful marksman, engaging and picking off her targets from a distance. Using her Crow Familiar to initiate fights by bleeding her targets, Vindicta may launch into Flight to keep her distance from enemies and tether them with a Stake in the ground while targeting them with her powerful rifle. Enemies that are near-death should fear her ability to Assassinate at long-range with a devastating sniper shot.

abilities.name: Stake
abilities.description: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.description: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

abilities.name: Crow Familiar
abilities.description: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.description: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

heroes.name: Viscous
heroes.playstyle: Viscous is a Hero in Deadlock. He's green. A psychic sea anemone in a protoplasmic suit, Viscous can throw Splatter to cover the area in green goo which slows down his victims and leaves them vulnerable to Puddle Punches, which will knock his enemies away from their friends and his friends away from their enemies. Even if they manage to catch Viscous it doesn't matter, as anything inside The Cube is completely invulnerable. Soon Goo Ball comes, and walls painted green will be joined by echoes of screams.

abilities.name: Splatter
abilities.description: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

abilities.name: The Cube
abilities.description: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.

abilities.name: Puddle Punch
abilities.description: Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup. Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. You and your allies have increased Air Control.

abilities.name: Goo Ball
abilities.description: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.

heroes.name: Vyper
heroes.playstyle: Vyper is a Hero in Deadlock. After Slithering across the battlefield to swiftly avoid enemy attacks while spraying them with copious amount of bullets, Vyper can inject retreating foes with Lethal Venom to finish them off and use her Screwjab Dagger to hit faraway targets. By slinging her Petrifying Bolas, Vyper will make sure that her targets won't get away from her.

abilities.name: Screwjab Dagger
abilities.description: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow. Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.

abilities.name: Lethal Venom
abilities.description: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health. Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

abilities.name: Slither
abilities.description: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

abilities.name: Petrifying Bola
abilities.description: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

heroes.name: Warden
heroes.role: Weakens his enemies and chases them down
heroes.playstyle: Warden is a Hero in Deadlock. He is a tough, tenacious brawler with endless determination and a technique for alchemy. Opening fights with either a Binding Word or a disrupting Alchemical Flask, Warden dashes into the fight to brawl at close range and utilizing his Willpower for protection and staying power. In desperate situations, Warden can trigger his Last Stand, damaging and stealing life from all foes in front of him.

abilities.name: Alchemical Flask
abilities.description: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

abilities.name: Willpower
abilities.description: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.

abilities.name: Binding Word
abilities.description: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.description: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.

heroes.name: Wraith
heroes.playstyle: Wraith is a Hero in Deadlock. She is a fast-talking and fast-firing combatant with potent offensive abilities and mobility. She can activate her Full Auto to boost her own fire rate, perform Card Tricks by sending them at her targets and Project Mind to teleport either into or out of dangerous fights. Singling out a foe with her Telekinesis and throwing them into any direction, Wraith can decide who on the enemy team should die first.

abilities.name: Card Trick
abilities.description: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. Alt-cast to throw first card

abilities.name: Project Mind
abilities.description: Teleport to the targeted location.

abilities.name: Full Auto
abilities.description: Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

heroes.name: Yamato
heroes.playstyle: Yamato is a Hero in Deadlock. She is a close-range assassin using precise strikes and sword attacks to destroy her foes. Conducting a Flying Strike with her grapple to get close, Yamato unleashes her powerful melee attacks along with Power Slash and Crimson Slash attacks to damage, slow, and disable her enemies while healing herself. Once fully engaged, she can unleash her Shadow Transformation to become infused with her brother's shadow soul, becoming unstoppable for a short time while ending the life of her opponents.

abilities.name: Power Slash
abilities.description: Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike. Press Ability 1 or Fire to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

abilities.name: Flying Slash
abilities.description: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

abilities.name: Crimson Slash
abilities.description: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

abilities.name: Shadow Transformation
abilities.description: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
